data.name: label2.Text
data.value: 📝 Registration Before using the system, every employee whether stationed at the entrance or exit must complete a registration process. To register, you need to enter your Name, Address, NIC, Age, and create a Password. Once you submit these details, the system will display a “Registration Successful” message along with your unique User ID. Make sure to note this User ID carefully, as you will use it to log in to the system. After registration, you can log in anytime by providing your User ID and Password on the login screen.

data.name: label3.Text
data.value: 🚗 Entrance Point If you are an employee working at an entrance point, your main task is to register vehicles that enter the highway from your location. After logging into the system, navigate to the vehicle registration section where you’ll enter the Vehicle Number, Vehicle Type, and the Entrance Point Name. Once saved, this data will be stored in the system and can later be retrieved by exit point employees to process the final billing. Always ensure that the vehicle details are entered accurately to maintain proper records.

data.name: label4.Text
data.value: 🧾 Exit Point If you are stationed at an exit point, your responsibility is to search for vehicles that are exiting the highway and generate their bills. After logging in, use the vehicle search feature to find a vehicle by entering its Vehicle Number. The system will display the vehicle’s entrance point and other details. You can then click the “Bill” button to generate the toll fee. A new form will appear showing the bill along with a “Print” button. Clicking this will print out the bill, which can be handed over to the driver. This ensures vehicles are properly charged for highway usage.
